Feedback on the inaugural flight from Guangzhou to Chiang Mai TEBAK Hanoi 132.3 FM, direct MC control LAPON Frequency Converter 124.1 TOMIP frequency switch at Bangkok 124.5, ready to downlink FL170. The commander might direct a direct flight to PUKAT. Use Z for ILS approach at gate 36 with MONLO2A The subsequent frequency conversion clearance approaches 129.6 At 6,600 feet,the aircraft attempted a ILS approach on Route 36, but was intercepted by the Yishuang interceptor, forcing an early deceleration.

清迈.text_en: Approach to 129.6 meters, first descend 11,000 feet, then 9,000 feet, and proceed straight to PUKAT. At 6,600 feet, you may perform a ILS approach approach. Feedback on the inaugural flight from Guangzhou to Chiang Mai TEBAK Hanoi 132.3 FM, direct MC control LAPON Frequency Converter 124.1 TOMIP frequency switch at Bangkok 124.5, ready to downlink FL170. The commander might direct a direct flight to PUKAT. Use Z for ILS approach at gate 36 with MONLO2A The subsequent frequency conversion clearance approaches 129.6 At 6,600 feet,the aircraft attempted a ILS approach on Route 36, but was intercepted by the Yishuang interceptor, forcing an early deceleration.
